stemMarkdown: The recurring decimal $0.\overline{11}$ (the block $11$ repeating) is written as a fraction in lowest terms. What is its denominator?
solutionMarkdown: A block of $2$ repeating digits sits over $99$: $0.\overline{11} = \dfrac{11}{99}$. Reducing by the HCF $11$ gives $\dfrac{1}{9}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: One repeating digit sits over 9, two over 99, three over 999 — the pattern continues.
